Agent Name: CodeExecutor  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred when the CodeExecutor provided incorrect lifespan calculations for Edward Albee and J. M. Barrie. The mistake was in the inversion of the lifespans calculated, leading to the incorrect conclusion that J. M. Barrie lived longer than Edward Albee, despite the gathered birth and death dates demonstrating otherwise. This miscommunication resulted from a computational or logical analysis error when executing the code, which misrepresented the lifespan durations.
